gloss: as much as possible; if possible

definitions.gloss: as much as possible; if possible
definitions.explanation: Indicates a desire to do something to the greatest extent circumstances allow.

examples.japanese: なるべく⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please come as early as possible.

examples.japanese: なるべく⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be as quiet as possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なるべく⟦{食|た}べるようにしています→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I try to eat vegetables as much as possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、なるべく⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{歩|ある}くようにしています→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: For my health, I try to walk every day as much as possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なるべく⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{考|かんが}えさせる→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{時|とき}→とき：10077_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}っている→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: I try to let my children think for themselves as much as possible, but I help when it's difficult.

notes:
なるべく expresses a soft preference or desire to do something to the extent possible.

なるべく vs ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧:
- なるべく: softer, preference-based ('if you can')
- ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧: stronger, effort-based ('do your best to')

COMMON PATTERNS:
- なるべく⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧: as soon as possible
- なるべく⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧: as cheaply as possible
- なるべく〜⟦ようにする→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧: to try to ~ as much as possible
- なるべく〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ようにする→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧: to try not to ~ as much as possible

USAGE:
- Often used in polite requests
- Implies flexibility - not an absolute requirement
- Can modify adjectives, verbs, or entire phrases

EXAMPLE NUANCES:
- なるべく⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: Please come if you can
- ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: Please make every effort to come

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become) + べく (in order to), meaning 'in order to make it happen'
